title: Software Development Team Sizing and Velocity Benchmarks
content:
Software Development Team Sizing and Velocity Benchmarks

Industry benchmarks for team composition, velocity, and productivity in software projects.

## Typical Team Sizes by Project Type

### Mobile App (Consumer-Facing)
- Lean MVP team (3–5 people): PM, 1 Full-stack Dev, 1 Mobile Dev, 1 Designer, 1 QA
- Standard team (6–9 people): PM, UI/UX Designer, 2 Mobile Devs, 2 Backend Devs, 1 AI/ML Engineer, 1 QA
- Large team (10–14 people): adds DevOps, Security Engineer, Data Engineer, 2nd QA
- Recommended for AI-powered consumer app: 7–9 people

### Enterprise Software
- Minimum viable: 5–7 people
- Standard: 8–15 people
- Large program: 15–30 people (multiple squads)

## Sprint Velocity Benchmarks (Agile/Scrum)
- Average story points per developer per sprint (2 weeks): 8–15 points
- A 7-person dev team (5 devs) delivers: 40–75 story points per sprint
- Typical feature complexity: Simple=1–3pts, Medium=5–8pts, Complex=13–20pts
- New team ramp-up: velocity is 50–60% of steady-state for first 2–3 sprints

## Task Parallelism — Key Principle
- iOS and Android development CAN and SHOULD run in parallel (separate engineers)
- Backend API development runs parallel to frontend once API contracts are defined (Week 2–4)
- AI/ML development can start after backend data models are defined
- QA begins integration testing when first features are backend-complete (not at the end)
- Payment integrations can all be built in parallel by 1–2 backend devs

## Role Rates (US Market, Blended Full-time + Contractor, 2024)
- Project Manager: $80–$130/hr ($100–$160K/yr salary)
- Business Analyst: $70–$110/hr ($85–$140K/yr)
- UI/UX Designer: $75–$125/hr ($90–$150K/yr)
- Solution Architect: $120–$180/hr ($150–$220K/yr)
- Senior Backend Developer: $110–$160/hr ($140–$200K/yr)
- Mid Backend Developer: $80–$120/hr ($100–$150K/yr)
- Senior Mobile Developer (iOS/Android): $110–$155/hr ($140–$195K/yr)
- Mid Mobile Developer: $80–$120/hr ($100–$150K/yr)
- AI/ML Engineer: $120–$175/hr ($150–$220K/yr)
- Senior QA Engineer: $70–$110/hr ($85–$140K/yr)
- DevOps/Cloud Engineer: $100–$150/hr ($125–$190K/yr)

## Critical Sizing Errors to Avoid
- Do NOT assign 2+ engineers to every role when 1 is sufficient (padding headcount)
- Do NOT serialize phases that can overlap (adds months of unnecessary delay)
- A single AI/ML engineer can handle AI feature development for most mobile apps
- QA should be ongoing (embedded in sprints), not a separate 7-month phase at the end
- Marketing/PR launch activities take 4–8 weeks, not months

## Realistic Full Team Example: AI Mobile App
- Phase 1 — Planning (Months 1–2): PM + BA only
- Phase 2 — Design (Months 2–4): PM + UI/UX Designer + BA
- Phase 3 — Development (Months 3–11): All devs (Mobile x2, Backend x2, AI/ML x1) + QA embedded
- Phase 4 — QA + Launch (Months 10–13): QA lead + DevOps + PM
- Total: 12–14 months end-to-end for full-featured AI consumer app
